name: HIP-3 dex xyz (trade[XYZ])

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The deployer is a 2-of-3 multisig, but two single keys can halt trading and settle any of its 120 markets at the mark price, so the multisig protects little. Open interest was about $3.9B at the 2026-09-16 read.
narrative.tag: same 3 signers as untracked HIP-4 venue txyz
narrative.detail: Two single-key sub-deployers can call haltTrading, which cancels all orders and settles positions at the mark price, and three single keys can change margin tables, open interest caps and funding parameters. The multisig only guards setSubDeployers and the deployer itself. A 1-of-6 sub-deployer can push the oracle, matching trade[XYZ]'s design of several relayers; protocol clamps (1% per update, 2.5 s apart) limit speed, not direction. No delay was found. The score describes key structure, not misuse. Whether the margin actions could force liquidations is unresolved, so they stay out of the score.

reproduce.note: this RPC answers for the latest block whatever block is asked (measured): the call reproduces the current value, not the one of the build

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key

independent_read.why: no code at this address on the chain's mainnet: a derived identifier for a native (non-EVM) entity such as HyperCore, or a contract that lives on another chain (a rollup's own L1 contracts); nothing for this reader to compare here
